homepage_scope: Existing general-purpose inclusion rules; each metric selects its own eligible winner(s).
task_order: ROC AUC available, descending ROC AUC; then balanced accuracy only, descending BA; ties by algorithm name.
ba_eligibility: Complete official test folds and matching sample IDs with finite probabilities in [0, 1] or consistently typed binary hard labels.
eligibility: Probability ROC AUC requires finite floating-point original probabilities in [0, 1] in every official fold; boolean and integer labels are excluded. Numerical checks cannot detect a cast of hard labels to floats, which the submission policy prohibits.
decision_rule: Probabilities: p > 0.5. Historical hard labels: saved decisions; their original thresholds may be unknown.
aggregation: Unweighted mean of official test-fold scores; population standard deviation (ddof=0). Not pooled out-of-fold AUC.
